representatives.extra: Joypurhat-1 (seat No. 34: Joypurhat Sadar and Panchbibi). Party: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. 13th Jatiya Sangsad election: 1,65,192 votes; runner-up Md Masud Rana (BNP; 'মোঃ মাসুদ রানা প্রধান' on Jugantor) 1,55,309 votes.
representatives.notes: Result reported 13 Feb 2026 (unofficial result at time of report). Bangla spelling from Jugantor candidate list.

representatives.extra: Joypurhat-2 (seat No. 35: Akkelpur, Kalai, Khetlal). Party: Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP). Other candidates: S.A. Zahid (AB Party), S.M. Rashedul Alam (Jamaat).
representatives.notes: Listed as winner ('জয়পুরহাট-২ আব্দুল বারী') in Dhaka Times list of BNP-won seats, 13 Feb 2026. Vote totals not found.
